title: Lord of the Boundless Curves of Space

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Lord of the boundless curves of space
To Your creative might we trace

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: Yours is the image stamped on man,
Though marred by man's own sin;

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: Give us to know Your truth; but more,
The strength to do Your will;
Until the love our souls adore
